quotes.text: Those who sent nothing harvested nothing; those who seized everything were trusted never again.
“Punish what you cannot measure,” he whispered. But Arin and Neris refused.
“Offer boldly when another has answered fairly.
At the sixth thaw, Arin approached Luma’s bridge
“Fog changes appearances, not faithful intent,” Neris said.
“Begin with bold trust; answer it with fair return; let both sides prosper; and meet small errors with patience.”

note: R1 covenant: seizers never trusted again; later laws condition bold giving on proven fairness; Varkos urges punishment, refused.

quotes.text: “Close the bridge,” he cried, “before uncertainty cheats you!”
let small distortions meet patience, not punishment.
a shadow whispered, “Keep everything; another’s trust is weakness.”
“Send boldly when fairness has earned faith.
At the seventh thaw, Arin carried four moonstones
They knew mist could alter appearances, whereas repeated generosity revealed intent.
“Let abundance begin with me,” he said.

note: Same Arin/Neris/Luma/Varkos world as partner; Varkos proposes closing bridge, rejected; giving conditioned on earned faith.
